exposure: monosialoteterahexosyl ganglioside (GM1) at doses of 50, 100, 150, and 200 microg/ml
outcome: differentiation of hUMSCs into neuron-like cells
expression levels of glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)
surface antigen expression profiles (CD73, CD90, CD105, CD11b, CD19, CD34, CD45, HLA-DR)
cohort: Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUMSCs) were obtained from umbilical cords of women with full-term pregnancies whose babies were delivered by cesarean section.
finding: GM1 effectively induces hUMSCs to differentiate into neuron-like cells, evidenced by changes in cell morphology and positive expression for MAP-2 and NF-H, but negative for GFAP.
